description: It is a familiar sight by this point for Chicago-area residents, but it’s still a fascinating spectacle as railroad workers light fires along rails during periods of cold weather. Metra workers did just that on Monday, lighting up fires in the afternoon and into the evening after a prolonged period of cold weather in the area. So why do workers light small fires along the rails? #chicago #chicagonews  #chicagowinter #metra #chicagoweather #chicagotiktok
